items.title: Fed Minutes Show Almost All Officials Expect More Rate Hikes
items.summary: Nearly all Federal Reserve officials agreed in October they would likely have to raise interest rates “in the months ahead” to return inflation to their 2% target in a timely manner.

items.title: One of AI's most notorious 'doomers' stands to make billions in Anthropic's IPO
items.summary: An Estonian tech billionaire famous for his stance that AI could end humanity is expected to be one of the biggest winners in Anthropic's upcoming IPO.

items.title: The Big Rotation Out of Equities Has Begun - Bloomberg.com
Aclara CEO Says Brazil Incentives Key as Firm Weighs Rare-Earth Plant Investment
items.summary: The head of Aclara Resources Inc. says Brazil needs to offer more incentives to miners as the firm weighs a future rare-earth separation plant in the largest South American nation.

items.title: US Refiners Cut Venezuelan Crude Oil Buys on High Freight Rates
items.summary: Higher freight rates have diminished US refiners’ appetite for Venezuelan crude, with imports set to slump to the lowest since the US moved to take control of the Latin American country’s oil riches.

items.title: How Anthropic’s Low-Profile CFO Helped Grow Startup Into AI Powerhouse - Bloomberg.com
Microsoft Says Copilot Is Beating Anthropic, OpenAI on Price
items.summary: Microsoft Corp. says customers are picking its Copilot AI assistant over Anthropic PBC’s Claude and OpenAI’s ChatGPT because it’s cheaper to operate.

Stocks Fall on Nvidia Selloff Before Anthropic IPO: Markets Wrap
items.summary: Wall Street saw renewed volatility as Nvidia Corp.’s post-earnings rally fizzled out, a sign that investors are looking for more evidence about the durability of the artificial-intelligence trade.

items.title: Anthropic Leveraged ETF Race Heats Up Even Before Stock’s Debut
items.summary: A slew of leveraged ETFs tied to SpaceX launched soon after its public debut, but only one managed to attract meaningful assets. That experience has raised the stakes for Anthropic: Issuers are racing to get out front in hopes that their fund becomes the one that captures the bulk of investor dollars.

items.title: AI is Forcing Firms to Fix Cyber Flaws Faster, Worsening Outages
items.summary: US officials say recent disruptions aren’t from cyberattacks.

items.title: Fed Minutes Leave Door Open to Larger December Rate Hike
items.summary: Minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee’s Oct. 27-28 meeting show nearly all Federal Reserve officials agreed they would likely have to raise interest rates “in the months ahead” to return inflation to their 2% target in a timely manner. Michael McKee reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Colombia Touts $43 Billion Investment Haul Amid Fiscal Strain
items.summary: Colombia secured $43.2 billion in investment and financing commitments during a three-day push to attract foreign capital in New York, more than double the government’s initial target.

items.title: US Carrier Leaves Persian Gulf for Japan, Leaving Two in Region
items.summary: One of three US aircraft carrier strike groups in the Persian Gulf region to enforce the naval blockade against Iran has left the region and is likely returning to its home port, according to two US officials.

items.title: Chicago’s Third CFO This Year Saw Red Flags Before Exit
items.summary: The sudden departure of Chicago’s third chief financial officer in a year came after she repeatedly raised concerns about budgeting practices, including inconsistent deficit calculations.
